value.title: Troubled Times Once Again! Advent of the Great Cataclysmic Warlord, Toyotomi Hideyoshi!
value.synopsis: Old rivalries resume at Kawanakajima as Sanada Yukimura battles Date Masamune and Takeda Shingen squares off against Uesugi Kenshin.  Meanwhile, the warlord Toyotomi Hideyoshi seeks ultimate domination in order to unify Japan.

value.title: The Lost Right Eye: The Dragon`s Back Rent Asunder!
value.synopsis: Under attack from all sides, Date Masamune is at a severe disadvantage without his strategist. Meanwhile, Takeda Shingen and Sanada Yukimura are on the move and preparing to outflank Toyotomi.

value.title: Keiji vs. Toshiie! Tedorigawa Choked with Unequivocal Ideals!
value.synopsis: Uesugi Kenshin faces Maeda Toshiie's invading army! Meanwhile, in the north, Date Masamune prepares to engage Katakura Kojuro, but finds one more obstacle in his way.

value.title: The Ghost of Azuchi Castle?! The Lamentation and Howl of Evil That Assail Yukimura!
value.synopsis: Sanada Yukimura encounters someone he thought was long dead. Meanwhile, Keiji’s contemplation of the past leads to a decision, and Mori Motonari and Takenaka Hanbei conclude their negotiations.

value.title: Engraved Pledge! The One-Eyed Dragon vs. the War God: Confrontation at Hitotoribashi!
value.synopsis: When Date’s path is blocked by Uesugi, he has a chance to reflect on the history he shares with Katakura. Meanwhile, Toyotomi prepares to invade Shikoku, and Sanada realizes that time is running out.

value.title: The Menacing Toyotomi-Mori Alliance! The Powerful Fist of Supremacy Cleaves the Sea!
value.synopsis: Toyotomi Hideyoshi takes on Chosokabe's seafaring fortress, the Fugaku. Meanwhile, Sanada is compelled to stray from his mission once again, and Keiji reunites with his aunt and uncle in Kaga.

value.title: To the Southernmost Land of Satsuma! A New Encounter as a Man for Yukimura!!
value.synopsis: While traveling to Osaka, Date encounters both Kai and Takeda. Meanwhile, Sanada is still shaken by Oyamada's death, but presses on to Satsuma in order to carry out his mission.

value.title: A Sad Reunion with a Friend: Memory of the Day Etched with Blinding Obsession
value.synopsis: Keiji reflects on the long history he shares with Toyotomi. Meanwhile, Sanada is allowed an opportunity to get to know Miyamoto and Shimazu better, and also gains some surprising insight into Mori.

value.title: Dragon and Ogre: Clash and Roar in Owari! The Combined Force of Date and Chosokabe
value.synopsis: Unaware of each other's identities, Date and Chosokabe clash! Meanwhile, Mori plots to further his own agenda while playing ally to Toyotomi - but Toyotomi and Takenaka have plans of their own.

value.title: The Young Tiger Restored! The Great Fortress Rebuilt: The Menace of the Sun Heads East!
value.synopsis: As Date and Chosokabe adjust their plans to attack Osaka, Mori plots to attack Toyotomi from the west. Meanwhile, Takeda and Uesugi attempt to outmaneuver Toyotomi in the east.

value.title: Toyotomi`s Great Main Army Dashes for Supremacy! Earnest Keiji Draws Sword in Heartbreak!
value.synopsis: Sarutobi and Kasuga run into trouble after making their way into Osaka Castle. Meanwhile, Mori unleashes the true power of his mobile fortress, much to Sanada’s alarm.

value.title: Azure and Crimson Do-or-Die Battle! To the Sound of the Breeze at the End of the Fierce Struggle!
value.synopsis: Battles are raging all across Japan! As Date faces off against Toyotomi at Odawara Castle, Sanada fights Mori’s mobile fortress. Meanwhile, Katakura finally gets his showdown with Takenaka.
